Kinchega National Park | The Kinchega National Park is a protected national park that is located in the Far West region of New South Wales, in eastern Australia.  The 44259 ha national park is located approximately 840 km west of Sydney and 111 km south-east of Broken Hill .  The park adjoins the town of Menindee .  The eastern edge of the Kinchega National Park is formed by the Darling River.
